full_prompt:
Draw a children's maths workbook illustration. A cosy pastel-coloured bakery counter with a pink background. A young child (age 5-6) wearing a small white apron stands on the LEFT, smiling proudly with arms slightly spread. On the counter surface in front of the child to the RIGHT, exactly 6 iced cupcakes are arranged in a single neat row. Each cupcake has a different coloured frosting: pink, blue, yellow, green, purple, orange. Cupcakes are evenly spaced, clearly separate, and easy to count individually. No extra baked goods or objects.

CRITICAL RULE: There must be EXACTLY 6 cupcake(s) — no more, no less. Count them before finishing.

ART STYLE: bright modern flat-design children's book illustration. Bold clean outlines. Warm vibrant pastel colours. NO text, NO numbers, NO labels anywhere in the image. Wide landscape composition. Objects must be large, clearly separated, easy to count. Characters should look natural and engaged with the scene. High quality, print-ready for a Year 1 maths workbook.
